{{Quote|Wraith Leader, you're clear to start your attack run. We detect no defensive emplacements on scanners, this should be easy.|TIE Fighter Squadron Chatter (intercepted)|<ref name="Shadow" />}}
'''Wraith Squadron''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was wiped out by the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'' some time before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Shadow" /><ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''The Force Unleashed II'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the databank have to happen before or in 1 BBY.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wraith Squadron was first mentioned in the "Rogue Shadow" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released on [[October 26]], [[2010]].
